chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bundar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from al-Jamourani, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Kulayb ibn Mu'awiya al-Asadi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever gets married has protected half of his religion.' And in another hadith: 'Let him then be mindful of God regarding the other half,' or 'the remainder.'

key_terms.أَحْرَزَ: Protected, secured, safeguarded — implying active preservation of something valuable
key_terms.فَلْيَتَّقِ اللَّهَ: Let him fear God / be mindful of God — an injunction to practice taqwa in all remaining matters
key_terms.نِصْفَ دِينِهِ: Half of his religion — metaphorically, marriage guards against sins related to unlawful desires

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about marriage and religion in this hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) narrates the Prophet's (s.a.w.w.) famous statement that marriage protects half of one's faith. The second variant from another narration adds that the person should then observe God-consciousness (taqwa) regarding the other half of the religion. This hadith reflects the Islamic understanding that marriage guards against sexual immorality and thereby protects a major dimension of one's religious practice and moral integrity.
word_analysis: so let him fear/be mindful of

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Al Jamourany, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Kuleyb Bin Moawiya Al Asady, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who married protects half his Religion’. And in another Hadeeth, ‘(He<sup>saww</sup> said): ‘So let him fear Allah<sup>azwj</sup> with regards to the other half’, or ‘the remainder’’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bandar has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Khalid from al-Jamuraniy from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn abu Hamzah from Kulayb ibn Mu‘awiyah al-Asadiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘By getting married one secures one-half of his religion.’ In another Hadith it is said that one must thereafter maintain piety before Allah about the other one-half.”
